## Inherited containers

The base module's quote, lazy continuation and nesting example:

```````````````````````````````` example
> quoted
> lazy
continued

> > nested
.
Document scope=1:1..5:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Callout scope=1:1..3:9 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
│   └── Paragraph scope=1:3..3:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=5
│       ├── Text scope=1:3..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="quoted" children=0
│       ├── SoftBreak scope=1:9..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
│       ├── Text scope=2:3..2:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="lazy" children=0
│       ├── SoftBreak scope=2:7..2:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
│       └── Text scope=3:1..3:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="continued" children=0
└── Callout scope=5:1..5:10 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
    └── Callout scope=5:3..5:10 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
        └── Paragraph scope=5:5..5:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
            └── Text scope=5:5..5:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal="nested" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Callouts module examples

```````````````````````````````` example
> quote
.
Document scope=1:1..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Callout scope=1:1..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
    └── Paragraph scope=1:3..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        └── Text scope=1:3..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="quote" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
> [!info]

> [!TIP] Title
.
Document scope=1:1..3:14 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Callout scope=1:1..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} variant="info" collapsed=null children=0
└── Callout scope=3:1..3:14 anchor=null attributes={} variant="TIP" collapsed=null children=0
    └── Title children=1
        └── Text scope=3:10..3:14 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Title" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
> [!custom-type]

> [!Note]
.
Document scope=1:1..3:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Callout scope=1:1..1:16 anchor=null attributes={} variant="custom-type" collapsed=null children=0
└── Callout scope=3:1..3:9 anchor=null attributes={} variant="Note" collapsed=null children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
> [!faq]+ Are callouts foldable?

> [!faq]- Are callouts foldable?
.
Document scope=1:1..3:32 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Callout scope=1:1..1:32 anchor=null attributes={} variant="faq" collapsed=false children=0
│   └── Title children=1
│       └── Text scope=1:11..1:32 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Are callouts foldable?" children=0
└── Callout scope=3:1..3:32 anchor=null attributes={} variant="faq" collapsed=true children=0
    └── Title children=1
        └── Text scope=3:11..3:32 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Are callouts foldable?" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
> [!note]Title

> [!faq]+Title

> x [!note]
.
Document scope=1:1..5:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
├── Callout scope=1:1..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
│   └── Paragraph scope=1:3..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Text scope=1:3..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[!note]Title" children=0
├── Callout scope=3:1..3:14 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
│   └── Paragraph scope=3:3..3:14 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Text scope=3:3..3:14 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[!faq]+Title" children=0
└── Callout scope=5:1..5:11 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
    └── Paragraph scope=5:3..5:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        └── Text scope=5:3..5:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x [!note]" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
>    [!note] x

>     [!note]
.
Document scope=1:1..3:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Callout scope=1:1..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} variant="note" collapsed=null children=0
│   └── Title children=1
│       └── Text scope=1:14..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x" children=0
└── Callout scope=3:1..3:13 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
    └── CodeBlock scope=3:7..3:13 anchor=null attributes={} info=null language=null literal="[!note]\n" fenced=false closed=true children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
>
> [!note] x
.
Document scope=1:1..2:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Callout scope=1:1..2:11 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
    └── Paragraph scope=2:3..2:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        └── Text scope=2:3..2:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[!note] x" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
> [!note] **bold** title
.
Document scope=1:1..1:24 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Callout scope=1:1..1:24 anchor=null attributes={} variant="note" collapsed=null children=0
    └── Title children=2
        ├── Strong scope=1:11..1:18 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        │   └── Text scope=1:13..1:16 anchor=null attributes={} literal="bold" children=0
        └── Text scope=1:19..1:24 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" title" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
> [!note] Title
> body
> more
.
Document scope=1:1..3:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Callout scope=1:1..3:6 anchor=null attributes={} variant="note" collapsed=null children=1
    ├── Title children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:11..1:15 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Title" children=0
    └── Paragraph scope=2:3..3:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
        ├── Text scope=2:3..2:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="body" children=0
        ├── SoftBreak scope=2:7..2:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
        └── Text scope=3:3..3:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="more" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
> [!note] T
> body
lazy
.
Document scope=1:1..3:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Callout scope=1:1..3:4 anchor=null attributes={} variant="note" collapsed=null children=1
    ├── Title children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:11..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="T" children=0
    └── Paragraph scope=2:3..3:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
        ├── Text scope=2:3..2:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="body" children=0
        ├── SoftBreak scope=2:7..2:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
        └── Text scope=3:1..3:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="lazy" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
> [!note] T
> ===
.
Document scope=1:1..2:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Callout scope=1:1..2:5 anchor=null attributes={} variant="note" collapsed=null children=1
    ├── Title children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:11..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="T" children=0
    └── Paragraph scope=2:3..2:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        └── Text scope=2:3..2:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="===" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
> [!outer]
> > [!inner] x
.
Document scope=1:1..2:14 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Callout scope=1:1..2:14 anchor=null attributes={} variant="outer" collapsed=null children=1
    └── Callout scope=2:3..2:14 anchor=null attributes={} variant="inner" collapsed=null children=0
        └── Title children=1
            └── Text scope=2:14..2:14 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
> [!note] %%t%%
.
Document scope=1:1..1:15 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Callout scope=1:1..1:15 anchor=null attributes={} variant="note" collapsed=null children=0
    └── Title children=1
        └── Comment scope=1:11..1:15 anchor=null attributes={} literal="t" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
> [!note] Title #t#
> body #p#
.
Document scope=1:1..2:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Callout scope=1:1..2:10 anchor=null attributes={} variant="note" collapsed=null children=1
    ├── Title children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:11..1:19 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Title #t#" children=0
    └── Paragraph scope=2:3..2:10 anchor="p" attributes={} children=1
        └── Text scope=2:3..2:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="body" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
> [!NOTE]
> text
.
Document scope=1:1..2:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Callout scope=1:1..2:6 anchor=null attributes={} variant="NOTE" collapsed=null children=1
    └── Paragraph scope=2:3..2:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        └── Text scope=2:3..2:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="text" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Title-only and empty-body fold states

```````````````````````````````` example
> [!note]

> [!note] Title

> [!note] → →

> [!note]+

> [!note]+ Title

> [!note]+ → →

> [!note]-

> [!note]- Title

> [!note]- → →
.
Document scope=1:1..17:14 anchor=null attributes={} children=9
├── Callout scope=1:1..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} variant="note" collapsed=null children=0
├── Callout scope=3:1..3:15 anchor=null attributes={} variant="note" collapsed=null children=0
│   └── Title children=1
│       └── Text scope=3:11..3:15 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Title" children=0
├── Callout scope=5:1..5:13 anchor=null attributes={} variant="note" collapsed=null children=0
├── Callout scope=7:1..7:10 anchor=null attributes={} variant="note" collapsed=false children=0
├── Callout scope=9:1..9:16 anchor=null attributes={} variant="note" collapsed=false children=0
│   └── Title children=1
│       └── Text scope=9:12..9:16 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Title" children=0
├── Callout scope=11:1..11:14 anchor=null attributes={} variant="note" collapsed=false children=0
├── Callout scope=13:1..13:10 anchor=null attributes={} variant="note" collapsed=true children=0
├── Callout scope=15:1..15:16 anchor=null attributes={} variant="note" collapsed=true children=0
│   └── Title children=1
│       └── Text scope=15:12..15:16 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Title" children=0
└── Callout scope=17:1..17:14 anchor=null attributes={} variant="note" collapsed=true children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Built-in types and aliases preserve spelling

The [official supported types](https://obsidian.md/help/callouts) and aliases
are stored as written; the trailing mixed-case, custom and minimal types use
the same grammar.

```````````````````````````````` example
> [!note]

> [!abstract]

> [!summary]

> [!tldr]

> [!info]

> [!todo]

> [!tip]

> [!hint]

> [!important]

> [!success]

> [!check]

> [!done]

> [!question]

> [!help]

> [!faq]

> [!warning]

> [!caution]

> [!attention]

> [!failure]

> [!fail]

> [!missing]

> [!danger]

> [!error]

> [!bug]

> [!example]

> [!quote]

> [!cite]

> [!NoTe]

> [!TIP]

> [!My_custom-9]

> [!9]

> [!_]

> [!-]
.
Document scope=1:1..65:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=33
├── Callout scope=1:1..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} variant="note" collapsed=null children=0
├── Callout scope=3:1..3:13 anchor=null attributes={} variant="abstract" collapsed=null children=0
├── Callout scope=5:1..5:12 anchor=null attributes={} variant="summary" collapsed=null children=0
├── Callout scope=7:1..7:9 anchor=null attributes={} variant="tldr" collapsed=null children=0
├── Callout scope=9:1..9:9 anchor=null attributes={} variant="info" collapsed=null children=0
├── Callout scope=11:1..11:9 anchor=null attributes={} variant="todo" collapsed=null children=0
├── Callout scope=13:1..13:8 anchor=null attributes={} variant="tip" collapsed=null children=0
├── Callout scope=15:1..15:9 anchor=null attributes={} variant="hint" collapsed=null children=0
├── Callout scope=17:1..17:14 anchor=null attributes={} variant="important" collapsed=null children=0
├── Callout scope=19:1..19:12 anchor=null attributes={} variant="success" collapsed=null children=0
├── Callout scope=21:1..21:10 anchor=null attributes={} variant="check" collapsed=null children=0
├── Callout scope=23:1..23:9 anchor=null attributes={} variant="done" collapsed=null children=0
├── Callout scope=25:1..25:13 anchor=null attributes={} variant="question" collapsed=null children=0
├── Callout scope=27:1..27:9 anchor=null attributes={} variant="help" collapsed=null children=0
├── Callout scope=29:1..29:8 anchor=null attributes={} variant="faq" collapsed=null children=0
├── Callout scope=31:1..31:12 anchor=null attributes={} variant="warning" collapsed=null children=0
├── Callout scope=33:1..33:12 anchor=null attributes={} variant="caution" collapsed=null children=0
├── Callout scope=35:1..35:14 anchor=null attributes={} variant="attention" collapsed=null children=0
├── Callout scope=37:1..37:12 anchor=null attributes={} variant="failure" collapsed=null children=0
├── Callout scope=39:1..39:9 anchor=null attributes={} variant="fail" collapsed=null children=0
├── Callout scope=41:1..41:12 anchor=null attributes={} variant="missing" collapsed=null children=0
├── Callout scope=43:1..43:11 anchor=null attributes={} variant="danger" collapsed=null children=0
├── Callout scope=45:1..45:10 anchor=null attributes={} variant="error" collapsed=null children=0
├── Callout scope=47:1..47:8 anchor=null attributes={} variant="bug" collapsed=null children=0
├── Callout scope=49:1..49:12 anchor=null attributes={} variant="example" collapsed=null children=0
├── Callout scope=51:1..51:10 anchor=null attributes={} variant="quote" collapsed=null children=0
├── Callout scope=53:1..53:9 anchor=null attributes={} variant="cite" collapsed=null children=0
├── Callout scope=55:1..55:9 anchor=null attributes={} variant="NoTe" collapsed=null children=0
├── Callout scope=57:1..57:8 anchor=null attributes={} variant="TIP" collapsed=null children=0
├── Callout scope=59:1..59:16 anchor=null attributes={} variant="My_custom-9" collapsed=null children=0
├── Callout scope=61:1..61:6 anchor=null attributes={} variant="9" collapsed=null children=0
├── Callout scope=63:1..63:6 anchor=null attributes={} variant="_" collapsed=null children=0
└── Callout scope=65:1..65:6 anchor=null attributes={} variant="-" collapsed=null children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Invalid types and fold boundaries

```````````````````````````````` example
> [!]

> [!a b]

> [!é]

> [!a.b]

> [!a/b]

> [!a\-b]

> [!note

> [!note]++ T

> [!note]-- T

> [!note]+x

> [!note]x

> [!note]! T

> \[!note]

> [!note] + title

> [!note] - title
.
Document scope=1:1..29:17 anchor=null attributes={} children=15
├── Callout scope=1:1..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
│   └── Paragraph scope=1:3..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Text scope=1:3..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[!]" children=0
├── Callout scope=3:1..3:8 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
│   └── Paragraph scope=3:3..3:8 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Text scope=3:3..3:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[!a b]" children=0
├── Callout scope=5:1..5:7 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
│   └── Paragraph scope=5:3..5:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Text scope=5:3..5:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[!é]" children=0
├── Callout scope=7:1..7:8 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
│   └── Paragraph scope=7:3..7:8 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Text scope=7:3..7:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[!a.b]" children=0
├── Callout scope=9:1..9:8 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
│   └── Paragraph scope=9:3..9:8 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Text scope=9:3..9:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[!a/b]" children=0
├── Callout scope=11:1..11:9 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
│   └── Paragraph scope=11:3..11:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Text scope=11:3..11:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[!a-b]" children=0
├── Callout scope=13:1..13:8 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
│   └── Paragraph scope=13:3..13:8 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Text scope=13:3..13:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[!note" children=0
├── Callout scope=15:1..15:13 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
│   └── Paragraph scope=15:3..15:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Text scope=15:3..15:13 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[!note]++ T" children=0
├── Callout scope=17:1..17:13 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
│   └── Paragraph scope=17:3..17:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Text scope=17:3..17:13 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[!note]-- T" children=0
├── Callout scope=19:1..19:11 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
│   └── Paragraph scope=19:3..19:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Text scope=19:3..19:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[!note]+x" children=0
├── Callout scope=21:1..21:10 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
│   └── Paragraph scope=21:3..21:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Text scope=21:3..21:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[!note]x" children=0
├── Callout scope=23:1..23:12 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
│   └── Paragraph scope=23:3..23:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Text scope=23:3..23:12 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[!note]! T" children=0
├── Callout scope=25:1..25:10 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
│   └── Paragraph scope=25:3..25:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Text scope=25:3..25:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[!note]" children=0
├── Callout scope=27:1..27:17 anchor=null attributes={} variant="note" collapsed=null children=0
│   └── Title children=1
│       └── Text scope=27:11..27:17 anchor=null attributes={} literal="+ title" children=0
└── Callout scope=29:1..29:17 anchor=null attributes={} variant="note" collapsed=null children=0
    └── Title children=1
        └── Text scope=29:11..29:17 anchor=null attributes={} literal="- title" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Extra indentation and title separators

```````````````````````````````` example
>  [!one] x

>   [!two] x

>    [!three]→x→→

>     [!code] x

> →[!tab] x

> [!note]→ **中😀** →
.
Document scope=1:1..11:24 anchor=null attributes={} children=6
├── Callout scope=1:1..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} variant="one" collapsed=null children=0
│   └── Title children=1
│       └── Text scope=1:11..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x" children=0
├── Callout scope=3:1..3:12 anchor=null attributes={} variant="two" collapsed=null children=0
│   └── Title children=1
│       └── Text scope=3:12..3:12 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x" children=0
├── Callout scope=5:1..5:17 anchor=null attributes={} variant="three" collapsed=null children=0
│   └── Title children=1
│       └── Text scope=5:15..5:15 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x" children=0
├── Callout scope=7:1..7:15 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
│   └── CodeBlock scope=7:7..7:15 anchor=null attributes={} info=null language=null literal="[!code] x\n" fenced=false closed=true children=0
├── Callout scope=9:1..9:11 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
│   └── Paragraph scope=9:4..9:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Text scope=9:4..9:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[!tab] x" children=0
└── Callout scope=11:1..11:24 anchor=null attributes={} variant="note" collapsed=null children=0
    └── Title children=1
        └── Strong scope=11:12..11:22 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
            └── Text scope=11:14..11:20 anchor=null attributes={} literal="中😀" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Only the opening line is metadata

```````````````````````````````` example
> first
> [!note] literal

>
> [!note] literal

> # head
> [!note] literal

> > [!inner] inner
> [!outer] literal
.
Document scope=1:1..11:18 anchor=null attributes={} children=4
├── Callout scope=1:1..2:17 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
│   └── Paragraph scope=1:3..2:17 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
│       ├── Text scope=1:3..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="first" children=0
│       ├── SoftBreak scope=1:8..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
│       └── Text scope=2:3..2:17 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[!note] literal" children=0
├── Callout scope=4:1..5:17 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
│   └── Paragraph scope=5:3..5:17 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Text scope=5:3..5:17 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[!note] literal" children=0
├── Callout scope=7:1..8:17 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=2
│   ├── Heading scope=7:3..7:8 anchor=null attributes={} level=1 children=1
│   │   └── Text scope=7:5..7:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="head" children=0
│   └── Paragraph scope=8:3..8:17 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Text scope=8:3..8:17 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[!note] literal" children=0
└── Callout scope=10:1..11:18 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=1
    └── Callout scope=10:3..11:18 anchor=null attributes={} variant="inner" collapsed=null children=1
        ├── Title children=1
        │   └── Text scope=10:14..10:18 anchor=null attributes={} literal="inner" children=0
        └── Paragraph scope=11:3..11:18 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
            └── Text scope=11:3..11:18 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[!outer] literal" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Lazy body starts on the second line

```````````````````````````````` example
> [!note] Title
lazy
continued

> [!note]
>    indented body
> more
````````````````````````````````
